title: Have You Ever…?
titleVi: Bạn đã từng…? (hiện tại hoàn thành)
intro: Have you ever done something amazing?

parentTip.vi: Chơi "Have you ever…?": lần lượt hỏi nhau "Have you ever eaten sushi?" và trả lời "Yes, I have." / "No, I haven't."
parentTip.say: Have you ever ridden a horse?

chat.ask: Have you ever flown in a plane?

gaps.s: Have you ever ___ in a plane?
Have you ever ___ a whale? Yes, I saw one in the sea.

text.title: Have You Ever…?
lines: Emma has been to lots of countries.
She has flown in a helicopter and she has ridden a camel in the desert.
She has never seen a volcano, but she wants to.
Next year, she is going to visit Italy.

questions.q: Where is she going to go next year?
